note: Hash pairs come from the git history of the GI-Model-Importer-Assets repository (PlayerCharacterData/<Name>/hash.json), diffed component by component, with reverted changes removed. The history stops covering fixes at 5.4 (last character hash changes 2025-02), so 5.5 to 7.2 hash changes are NOT in this file. They exist only in SilentNightSound "Fix All Character Mods" (GameBanana 16433, licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, version 7.2 from 2026-11-06), whose data was not copied. Version labels: taken from the commit message when it names one, otherwise from the official release date of the commit day (flagged "version from date" in note). A pair can be wrong when the repo author re-dumped a character (the 5.2 block, "Characters re-dump", has 89 pairs from one commit), so treat unverified pairs as hints for detection, not as proof.

sources.author: ZaRe4p3r
sources.used: rule description only, taken from the GameBanana text; no code or data copied

rules.detail: ORFix (outline and reflection fix) applier. GIMI ships ORFix.ini and ORFixAPI.ini in its Core libraries (installed and kept current by XXMI). The applier edits every mod ini so that the mod calls ORFix instead of binding textures by raw slot, which keeps outlines and reflections correct after a hash or slot change. It only handles characters released when the script was built and not complex toggle mods. Ini text edit only, but it needs the character list from the script (not read). Maintained now by LeoMods_ (version 4.2, 2026-02). Separate tools: Face Fix Updated (Sanddino, tool 21052) changes ps-t lines to this and removes run = ORFix lines in face sections; ORFix Applier Tool for Complex Toggle Mods (tool 21138).

5.4 changed how character normal maps work. SilentNightSound states this cannot be automated: the mod author has to replace the old normal map with the new equivalent. Show a "needs an update from the author" state for mods that still use the old normal map hashes of 5.3 or older.

Genshin 5.7 moved the character texture slots. In every active ini that was not already patched, replace the slot names on lines "ps-t0 = ...", "ps-t1 = ..." and "ps-t2 = ..." with ps-t6, ps-t0 and ps-t1 in that order (ps-t0 becomes ps-t6, ps-t1 becomes ps-t0, ps-t2 becomes ps-t1), then add a marker comment at the top so a second run does nothing. Ini text edit only. Described in the GameBanana text of the tool (the tool is marked outdated by its author, so check against a current mod before shipping). The script itself was not read.

upstream.format: json per character (hash.json) plus git history
upstream.notes: Each hash.json is an array of components {component_name, root_vs, draw_vb, position_vb, blend_vb, texcoord_vb, ib, object_indexes, object_classifications, texture_hashes [[ [type, ext, hash] ]], first_vs}. GitHub API: /repos/SilentNightSound/GI-Model-Importer-Assets/commits?path=PlayerCharacterData/<Name>/hash.json lists the revisions, then raw.githubusercontent.com/.../<sha>/PlayerCharacterData/<Name>/hash.json for each. Diff consecutive revisions. This repo has gone quiet for GI after 2025-02, so for new versions this feed is not enough.

_aFiles[] lists gifixversionNN.exe and .zip (source) with _tsDateAdded. A new file name or a newer date means a new GI fix has been released: use it to raise the "new fixer available" notice and open the page.
